D1.name: Rashi Chart
D1.calculationRule: Direct placement in natal sidereal sign

D2.name: Hora (Wealth & Prosperity)
D2.calculationRule: 15-degree division: Odd signs Sun/Leo 0-15 then Moon/Cancer 15-30; Even signs Moon/Cancer 0-15 then Sun/Leo 15-30

D3.name: Drekkana (Siblings & Courage)
D3.calculationRule: 10-degree decanate division: 1st self, 2nd 5th from self, 3rd 9th from self

D4.name: Chaturthamsa (Fortune & Fixed Assets)
D4.calculationRule: 7.5-degree quadrant division: 1st self, 2nd 4th from self, 3rd 7th from self, 4th 10th from self

D7.name: Saptamsa (Children & Progeny)
D7.calculationRule: 4.2857-degree division: Odd signs start from self; Even signs start from 7th from self

D9.name: Navamsha (Spouse & Destiny)
D9.calculationRule: 3.3333-degree division: Fiery signs from Aries, Earthy from Capricorn, Airy from Libra, Watery from Cancer

D10.name: Dasamsa (Career & Profession)
D10.calculationRule: 3-degree division: Odd signs start from self; Even signs start from 9th from self

D12.name: Dwadasamsa (Parents & Lineage)
D12.calculationRule: 2.5-degree division: Starts from self for all signs

D16.name: Shodashamsha (Vehicles & Desires)
D16.calculationRule: 1.875-degree division: Movable signs from Aries, Fixed from Leo, Dual from Sagittarius

D20.name: Vimshamsha (Spiritual Progress & Worship)
D20.calculationRule: 1.5-degree division: Movable signs from Aries, Fixed from Sagittarius, Dual from Leo

D24.name: Chaturvimshamsha (Knowledge & Higher Learning)
D24.calculationRule: 1.25-degree division: Odd signs from Leo; Even signs from Cancer

D27.name: Saptavimshamsha / Bhamsa (Strengths & Vulnerabilities)
D27.calculationRule: 1.1111-degree division: Fiery from Aries, Earthy from Cancer, Airy from Libra, Watery from Capricorn

D30.name: Trimsamsa (Misfortunes & Arishta)
D30.calculationRule: Unequal degrees: Odd signs Mars 5, Saturn 5, Jupiter 8, Mercury 7, Venus 5; Even signs Venus 5, Mercury 7, Jupiter 8, Saturn 5, Mars 5

D40.name: Khavedamsa (Auspicious Effects & Virtues)
D40.calculationRule: 0.75-degree division: Odd signs start from Aries; Even signs start from Libra

D45.name: Akshavedamsa (General Character & Well-being)
D45.calculationRule: 0.6667-degree division: Movable signs from Aries, Fixed from Leo, Dual from Sagittarius

D60.name: Shashtiamsa (Past Life Karma & Deep Potential)
D60.calculationRule: 0.5-degree division: Starts from self across 60 half-degree portions
